course:
I think the senior project could start from the beginning of the previous semester, so we would have more time to explore, change ideas, and develop the project properly.
Also, the attendance policy also felt unnecessarily strict, especially since everyone has a different way of working on such a large project.
Another issue is the high credit of this course dueing this 4 yeears, especially in this semester. We could have the opportunity to take other useful electives and learn different things, instead of just sitting in the studio.

instructor:
Efe Hoca is really good in subjects he’s interested in, but in this course he felt a bit monotone and the classes were honestly kind of boring. Since it was his first time teaching and the course itself has its own issues, I don’t think there was that much he could do. Maybe he could be a bit less serious about it.
Also, the grading felt pretty strict, especially since we’re all 4th-year students focusing on our senior projects and trying to get good grades. In previous years, students didn’t even have classes toward the end of the semester, so having this many assignments, especially during finals week, didn’t feel very reasonable.
course:

The number of projects was also too much and they got much more time consuming just when we have to deal with our senior peojects. I think some of these projects were really unnecessary.
The timing of the course is also off, because most of the things we were supposed to learn here are things we actually needed a year ago. I think the course really needs a renewal. I know that Çavlan and Efe Hoca tried their best and even asked for our opinions to improve things, but in the end, we were the ones who had to deal with the problems of this class.

course: - Ders online eğitim için baya uygun, herkes PCsine indiriyor Cinema 4D yi, okulun sağladığı öğrenci lisansı da var. Ders parametrik dizayn üzerine kurulu, en son projede de bize verilen konseptler üzerine bir dizayn yapıyoruz. Genel olarak dizayn ve projeler üzerine güzel uygulamalara giriş için harika bir ders: Cinema 4D, Xpresso, Asana Board, Miro Board. Derste sahne dizaynı, shading, rendering üzerine pek durulmuyor ama zaten bu konularda internet üzerinde baya bi kaynak var. Dersi alacak olan ama majoru GRA olmayan arkadaşlar içinse final projesi için gerekli olacak dizayn metodlarından biraz mahrum kalacaksınız, yabancı olacak sizlere ama üstesinden gelebilirsiniz bunun.
